claims.text: The F1 scores achieved were 0.94 for the Wikipedia and Twitter datasets, and 0.95 for the Formspring dataset, with an accuracy of 98%.
The previous best F1 scores for the Wikipedia and Twitter datasets were 0.68 and 0.93, respectively.
The accuracy score for the Formspring dataset using the authors' method was reported as 78.5%.
Traditional machine learning models showed significantly lower performance compared to DNN models in cyberbullying detection.
